findings.claim: The fix that reruns sanitizeName after the 30-character cut is only exercised by the existing random 50-run idempotence test, which is the same test that was flaking, so there is no test that reliably fails if this fix is reverted; the bug only triggers in roughly 1 in 1,400 runs, and a simulated revert only failed the suite about 0.05% of the time, meaning a regression could go unnoticed until CI flakes again.

The bulk swap produced `if (app) await app?.close();`, where the optional-chaining `?.` is redundant because the preceding `if (app)` check already guards the call and nothing can change `app` in between.
The bulk swap produced `if (app) { await app?.close(); }`, where the `?.` is redundant given the surrounding `if (app)` check, the same issue as in the feature-flag integration spec.
